answer: Locks are entered in gale, expire in fable, and timber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 42 aliases therefore needs 15 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4005 identities would post 1854 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
